text:
Your biggest enemy isn't rejection. It's your own silence.

You filter every word. Never say the controversial thought. You play it safe.

You're not being smart. You're being invisible.

Attraction happens when a man has an opinion and says it. Even the ones some people will hate.

Women aren't attracted to approval seeking. They're attracted to men who don't need it.

Speak the real opinion. Lose the wrong women. Keep the right ones.
caption:
Men with real mindset speak their minds. Send this to a man who needs it today.
